cues.squat_back_straight: Keep your back straight, chest up
cues.squat_knees_out: Push your {side} knee out|Push your knees out
cues.squat_go_lower: Go lower, bend your knees more
cues.lunge_knee_behind_toes: Keep your front knee behind your toes
cues.lunge_go_lower: Go lower, drop your back knee
cues.bridge_hips_higher: Lift your hips higher, squeeze your glutes
cues.wallsit_lower: Slide lower, thighs parallel to the floor
cues.wallsit_back_flat: Keep your back flat on the wall
cues.deadlift_bar_close: Keep the weight close to your legs
cues.deadlift_hips_up: Hips higher, this is a hinge not a squat
cues.pullup_chin_over_bar: Pull higher, chin over the bar
cues.gm_soft_knees_only: Keep your knees only slightly bent
cues.gm_hinge_lower: Hinge lower, push your hips back
cues.pushup_hips_high: Hips too high, lower your hips
cues.pushup_go_lower: Go lower, chest towards the floor
cues.pike_go_lower: Lower your head closer to the floor
cues.curl_elbow_tucked: Keep your {side} elbow tucked at your side|Keep your elbow tucked at your side
cues.triceps_ribs_down: Keep your ribs down, don't arch
cues.kickback_elbow_up: Keep your upper arm up and still
cues.dip_chest_up: Chest up, stay close to the bench
cues.press_no_lean: Don't lean back, brace your core
cues.lateral_shoulder_height: Stop your {side} arm at shoulder height|Stop at shoulder height
cues.lateral_raise_higher: Raise your arms to shoulder height
cues.front_raise_higher: Raise your arms to shoulder height
cues.upright_row_higher: Pull your elbows up to shoulder height
cues.superman_lift_higher: Lift your arms and legs higher
cues.crunch_lift_higher: Lift your shoulders a little higher
cues.vup_reach_higher: Reach higher, lift arms and legs together
cues.deadbug_extend_further: Extend your arm and leg further
cues.climber_knee_higher: Drive your knee closer to your chest
cues.birddog_extend_further: Reach your arm and leg out longer
cues.hollow_legs_up: Lift your legs a little, keep your back down
cues.hydrant_lift_higher: Lift your knee higher to the side
cues.jack_arms_higher: Bring your arms all the way up
cues.plank_hips_high: Hips too high, lower your hips
cues.step_back: Step back so the camera can see you
cues.warmup: Start with a five minute warm-up
cues.cooldown: Finish with a gentle stretch to cool down
